text:
emma: Heads-up: after we switched to conditional exports in js-sdk@2.4.x a couple of onboarding reports came in. Cloudflare/Vite dev builds fail with "Cannot use import statement outside a module" and TypeScript picks up wrong types (points at cjs d.ts). Also some customers saw middleware auth fire twice.
ryan: Do we have the export map in the repo?
emma: snippet I saw: 
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```

jess: Typical bundler interplay: Vite + wrangler sometimes resolves the import condition at build time but still wraps modules into a CommonJS shim for dev server HMR. If the shipped file is .mjs but ends up in a cjs wrapper you get that syntax error.
marco: The TS typing issue is probably because package.json `types` or `typings` still points to `dist/cjs/index.d.ts` (or we didn't include a conditional `types` field), so consumers using ESM import get wrong declarations. That can cause confusing IDE/autocomplete mismatches during onboarding.
emma: Repro steps I used: 1) clone sample-edge-vite 2) npm i redwood-js-sdk@2.4.0 3) start dev with wrangler pages dev + vite 4) open page -> console syntax error and network shows two POST /v1/tokens.
ryan: Double auth could be two separate instances of the SDK loaded (esm vs cjs) or our init running twice because of HMR re-eval. We should make init idempotent and add a module-level guard.
jess: Short-term mitigation: update the sample to import the explicit ESM edge entry `import { Redwood } from 'redwood-js-sdk/dist/esm/edge.mjs'` and set TS config to point to correct types. Not great but reduces customer friction.
marco: Long-term: options are: 1) add a conditional `types`/`typings` mapping in exports (Node recently supports conditional exports for types in some tools), 2) publish a small `dist/esm/edge.mjs` + `dist/esm/index.mjs` and document explicit edge import, 3) harden SDK init to be safe against duplicate loads, and 4) add an edge CI check.
emma: I filed RDW-5401 to track (labels: devex, exports, types, edge). @sdk-bot can you create the ticket?
sdk-bot: Created RDW-5401: "Export map caused ESM/CJS mismatch, types mismatch, and duplicate init in edge samples" (labels: devex, exports, types, edge)
ryan: I'll add a tiny idempotency guard in auth init and also log module resolution path so we can detect duplicate instances. Jess can update samples/docs with explicit import and TS tips. Marco can check package.json `types` and whether bundlers respect conditional typings.
marco: FYI patched sample PR: github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/130 adds explicit ESM import + a note for Vite/wrangler flags.
emma: Please also add a short troubleshooting blurb in the SDK README: "If you see import errors in Cloudflare/Vite dev, try explicit ESM entry or ensure your bundler preserves .mjs semantics."
jess: Agreed. Also add a small CI job that runs the Vite+Wrangler dev server smoke check against the edge sample to catch regressions early.
ryan: I'll try a release patch v2.4.1 with the init guard and updated debug logs. If that looks safe we keep exports as-is and rely on docs + sample fixes rather than reverting the export map.
emma: thanks team. Good to catch before more customers hit it.
